title: data for diagram.restore
description: Write a new revision whose content is revision to_rev of the attached diagram (404 rev_not_found). rev = current + 1; contentRev = current + 1 when the content differs from the current revision, else unchanged; stamps recomputed. No revision is ever deleted. Ids of to_rev that were removed since come back (a restore is not an id reuse). Reads only the to_rev blob, never the current one. Rev 2 (M1): owner (UI credential) always. Coordinator: on a pinned diagram 409 needs_owner_act (DO: diagram.propose with restore_to and a bound ask); on an unpinned diagram allowed unless it is a bulk removal (contract 3.4: more than 10 nodes or 20 edges removed by coordinator lines since the last owner act), else 409 needs_owner_act. No evidence field: an owner note never backs a restore. An owner restore that bumps contentRev writes the pointer message. Rev 3 (contract 3.7): owner-only, needs an owner device (TOTP step-up once per device); otherwise 403 owner_device_required. Rev 3: the coordinator never restores directly (403 forbidden_for_role); it proposes restore_to with a bound ask.
x-pinned: n/a (owner only; the coordinator proposes restore_to)
